docs.title: CheesyScripts Documentation
docs.text:
Official technical guides for our FiveM resources.

Welcome to the central hub for CheesyScripts. This site provides installation steps, configuration guides, and export references for all our released products. Select a script from the sidebar to get started.

docs.title: Global Requirements
docs.text:
Before installing any of our scripts, ensure your server meets these baseline requirements to avoid any "lactose intolerance" (script errors):

  • FXServer Artifacts: Version 5848 or higher is recommended.
  • OneSync: Enabled (Required for most modern networking features).
  • Database: oxmysql .

docs.title: Installation Flow
docs.text:
All CheesyScripts follow a standardized installation process:

  1. Download: Claim your asset from FiveM Keymaster.
  2. Placement: Extract the folder into your resources/ directory (e.g., resources/[cheesy]).
  3. Config: Edit the config.lua to match your framework (ESX/QB/Standalone).
  4. Start: Add ensure [script_name] to your server.cfg.

Optimization

All CheesyScripts are built with performance as a core focus. We aim for high-efficiency loops and clean event handling to ensure your server stays responsive under load.

docs.title: Support & Links
docs.text:
If you encounter any issues not covered in these docs:

  • Discord Support — Open a ticket for 1-on-1 assistance.
  • Tebex Store — Browse our latest premium releases.

docs.title: Developer Note
docs.text:
We use Escrow for our premium scripts, but we keep the config.lua and most client/server events open so you can still bridge them into your own custom frameworks.

Stay Gouda.

docs.title: 🚗 cs_carlock Documentation
docs.text: cs_carlock is a fully configurable vehicle key and locking system for FiveM. It provides vehicle locking, key sharing, lockpicking, tracking, and admin tools with support for multiple frameworks.

docs.title: 📦 Installation
docs.text:
1. Place cs_carlock inside your resources folder
  2. Add to your server.cfg:

ensure cs_carlock
3. Configure the Config file to match your server setup

docs.title: ⚙️ Configuration Guide
docs.text: Below is a full explanation of the provided configuration file.

docs.title: 🔍 Version Check
docs.text:
Config.VersionCheck = true
Option Description true Console will notify if the script is outdated false Disable version checking

docs.title: 🚘 Plate Whitelist
docs.text:
Config.plateWhiteList = {
    "lily",
    "police",
    "admin"
}

Vehicles with these plates:

  • Do NOT require keys
  • Can always be accessed

docs.title: 🔑 Engine Behavior
docs.text:
Config.canLeaveEngineRunning = true
Config.canDriveIfEngineRunning = true

docs.title: canLeaveEngineRunning
docs.text:
• true → Short press exit = engine off
  • Long press exit = engine stays on

docs.title: canDriveIfEngineRunning
docs.text:
• true → Anyone can drive away if engine is running
  • false → Keys are always required

docs.title: 🔐 Key Sharing System
docs.text:
Config.enableKeySharing = true
Config.onlyVehicleOwnerCanShare = true
Option Description enableKeySharing Enables the key sharing system onlyVehicleOwnerCanShare Only first key receiver (vehicle owner) can share

docs.title: 💬 Commands Configuration
docs.text: Config.Commands = { ... }

docs.title: 🚗 Lock / Unlock Command
docs.text:
unlockVehicle = {
    command = "lockvehicle",
    keyMapping = "u",
    keyMappingDesc = "Use vehicle keys",
    chatSuggestion = "Use vehicle keys"
}
Setting Description command Chat command keyMapping Default keybind keyMappingDesc Description in keybind menu chatSuggestion Chat suggestion text

Set to nil to disable keymapping or chat suggestion.

docs.title: 🗝️ View Keys Command
docs.text:
viewKeys = {
    command = "keys",
    keyMapping = nil,
    chatSuggestion = nil
}

Command to open the keys menu.

docs.title: 🛠️ Admin Key Command
docs.text:
adminGetKey = {
    command = "getkey",
    perms = { ... }
}

Allows admins to obtain vehicle keys.

Usage:

/getkey
/getkey ABC123

docs.title: 🔐 Permission Framework
docs.text:
permsFramework = "aceperms"

Supported frameworks:

  • esx
  • qbcore
  • vrp
  • aceperms
  • identifiers

Each framework has its own permission list:

['esx'] = {'superadmin', 'admin', 'mod'}

docs.title: 🔓 Lockpicking System
docs.text: Config.lockpicking = { ... }

docs.title: Enable / Disable
docs.text:
isEnabled = true

Enables lockpicking for vehicles requiring keys.

docs.title: Ignore Vehicle Classes
docs.text:
ignoreVehicleClass = {
    18, -- Emergency
    19, -- Military
    21  -- Trains
}

Vehicle classes reference: https://wiki.rage.mp/wiki/Vehicle_Classes

These classes cannot be lockpicked.

docs.title: Required Item
docs.text:
item = "lockpick"
itemLostOnFail = true
  • item → Required inventory item
  • itemLostOnFail → Removes item on failed attempt

docs.title: Minigame Options
docs.text:
minigame = "default"

Available types:

Type Description default Built-in Fallout/Skyrim style minigame skill-check ox_lib skillcheck none 7 second progressbar

docs.title: Car Alarm
docs.text:
carAlarmOnFail = true
carAlarmDuration = 30

If lockpicking fails:

  • Alarm triggers
  • Audio bank configurable
  • Duration must be a number (seconds)

docs.title: 📡 Vehicle Tracker System
docs.text:
tracker = {
    enabled = true,
    options = {
        trackerItem = "gpstracker",
        ownedVehicleTable = "owned_vehicles",
        trackerDuration = 300,
    }
}

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Install GPS tracker on vehicles
  • Requires trackerItem
  • Only works on owned vehicles
  • Tracking lasts trackerDuration seconds

docs.title: 🌍 Localization
docs.text:
You can fully modify notification and UI text:

Config.Locales = {
    plate = "plate",
    vehicleLocked = "Vehicle Locked",
    vehicleUnlocked = "Vehicle unlocked",
    ...
}

All displayed text can be customized here.

docs.title: 📖 Feature Overview
docs.text: ✔ Vehicle Lock / Unlock ✔ Key Ownership System ✔ Key Sharing ✔ Admin Key Command ✔ Lockpicking with Minigame ✔ Car Alarm System ✔ Vehicle GPS Tracker ✔ Multi-Framework Permission Support

docs.title: 🧩 Example Use Cases
docs.text:
• Police vehicles protected from lockpicking
  • Admins able to recover keys
  • Criminal RP with tracker & alarm system
  • Shared company vehicles
  • Public vehicles without keys

docs.title: 🛠️ Support
docs.text: If you encounter issues: 1. Enable Config.VersionCheck 2. Check console logs 3. Verify permission framework 4. Ensure required items exist in your inventory system

docs.title: 📅 cs_daily Documentation
docs.text: cs_daily is a fully configurable daily & weekly quest system for FiveM. Players complete quests, earn rewards, and maintain login streaks — with VIP support, leaderboards, and an in-game admin menu.

docs.title: 📦 Installation
docs.text:
1. Place cs_daily inside your resources folder
  2. Import installation/query.sql into your database
  3. Add to your server.cfg:
ensure ox_lib
ensure oxmysql
ensure cs_daily

Make sure ox_lib and oxmysql start before cs_daily.

  1. Configure shared/config.lua to match your server setup

docs.title: 🔍 Version Check
docs.text:
Config.VersionCheck = true
Option Description true Console will notify if the script is outdated false Disable version checking

docs.title: 🌐 General
docs.text:
Config.General = {
    ServerName = "My Server",
    Locale = "en",
    ResetTime = 0,
    MinimumHoursBetweenClaims = 20,
    StreakGracePeriodHours = 4,
    DailyQuestCount = 3,
    EnableWeeklyQuests = true,
    WeeklyQuestCount = 2,
    InteractionType = "auto",
    EnableWeekendBonus = true,
    WeekendMultiplier = 1.5,
    UpdateInterval = 5000,
}
Option Description ServerName Displayed in the UI header Locale Language: en, nl, de ResetTime Hour of day quests reset (0–23, 0 = midnight) MinimumHoursBetweenClaims Prevents players from gaming the reset StreakGracePeriodHours Hours after reset where streak is still maintained DailyQuestCount How many daily quests each player gets (1–5 recommended) EnableWeeklyQuests Toggle the weekly quest system WeeklyQuestCount Number of weekly quests per player (1–3 recommended) InteractionType auto, ox_target, qb-target, or zones EnableWeekendBonus Apply a reward multiplier on Saturday & Sunday WeekendMultiplier Multiplier applied on weekends (1.5 = 50% bonus) UpdateInterval How often quest progress updates in ms (default: 5000)

docs.title: 🎨 Branding
docs.text:
Config.Branding = {
    Colors = {
        primary = "#FFC107",
        ...
    },
    Logo = "open/logo.svg",
    FontFamily = "Chakra Petch",
}
Option Description Colors UI color palette (primary, text, accent, danger, success, etc.) Logo Path to your logo — supports .svg, .png, .jpg FontFamily Chakra Petch, JetBrains Mono, or Syne

docs.title: 🔥 Streak System
docs.text:
Config.Streak = {
    Protection = {
        Enabled = true,
        AutoUseFreeze = true,
        FreeFreezesPerMonth = 2,
        MaxFreezes = 5,
        PurchasableFreeze = true,
        FreezeCost = {money = 25000, moneyType = "bank"},
    },
}
Option Description Enabled Enable streak freeze protection AutoUseFreeze Auto-use a freeze when a player misses a day FreeFreezesPerMonth Number of free freezes given per month MaxFreezes Maximum freezes a player can hold PurchasableFreeze Allow players to buy freezes FreezeCost Cost to buy a freeze (bank, cash, or money)

docs.title: Streak Multipliers
docs.text:
Defined in open/quests.lua:

Streak Multiplier Badge 3 days ×1.1 🔥 7 days ×1.25 🔥🔥 14 days ×1.5 🔥🔥🔥 30 days ×2.0 ⭐ 60 days ×2.5 ⭐⭐ 100 days ×3.0 💎 365 days ×5.0 👑

docs.title: Streak Milestones
docs.text: One-time rewards at milestone streaks (7, 30, 60, 100, 365 days). Defined in open/quests.lua.

docs.title: 💎 VIP System
docs.text:
Config.VIP = {
    Enabled = false,
    DetectionMethod = "custom",
    Tiers = {
        standard = {multiplier = 1.0},
        vip      = {multiplier = 1.5},
        vipplus  = {multiplier = 2.0},
    },
}
Option Description Enabled Toggle the VIP reward multiplier system DetectionMethod ace (ACE permissions) or custom (via open/custom.lua) Tiers Define multipliers per VIP tier

Custom VIP detection is handled in open/custom.lua → Custom.GetVIPTier.

docs.title: 🏆 Leaderboard
docs.text:
Config.Leaderboard = {
    Enabled = true,
    ShowTop = 25,
    RefreshInterval = 300000,
    Categories = {
        {id = "current", label = "Current Streak"},
        {id = "longest", label = "Longest Streak"},
        {id = "claims",  label = "Total Claims"},
    },
}
Option Description Enabled Show the leaderboard tab in the UI ShowTop Number of players shown RefreshInterval How often the leaderboard refreshes (ms) Categories Leaderboard tabs/categories

docs.title: 🛠️ Admin
docs.text:
Config.Admin = {
    EnableAdminCommands = true,
    DevMode = false,
}

Grant admin access in server.cfg:

add_ace group.admin cs_daily.admin allow
add_principal identifier.fivem:YOUR_ID group.admin

In-game command: /dailyadmin

Admin menu options: - View Player Stats - Set Player Streak - Give Streak Freezes - Reset Today's Quests - Wipe All Player Data

docs.title: 📋 Quest Configuration
docs.text: All quests are defined in open/quests.lua.

docs.title: Quest Types
docs.text: Type Description instant Claim immediately — no action required time Stay online for X seconds location Travel to a specific location activity Drive or walk a set distance task Perform an animation at a location collect Collect props from spawn locations on the map

docs.title: Difficulty Pools
docs.text:
Quests are split into easy, medium, and hard pools, each with a weight that controls how often they appear.

Config.DailyQuestPools = {
    easy   = {weight = 50, quests = { ... }},
    medium = {weight = 30, quests = { ... }},
    hard   = {weight = 20, quests = { ... }},
}

Weekly quests use the same format under Config.WeeklyQuestPools.

docs.title: Adding a Quest
docs.text:
{
    id = "my_quest",
    type = "task",
    title = "My Custom Quest",
    description = "Do something cool",
    icon = "⭐",
    difficulty = "medium",
    preset = "dance",
    location = vector3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
    radius = 5.0,
    duration = 30,
    rewards = {
        money = 3000,
        items = {
            {name = "lockpick", amount = 2},
        }
    },
}

docs.title: Task Presets
docs.text:
Predefined animations for task quests. Defined in open/quests.lua.

Preset Description dance Dance animation clean Broom cleaning mow Lawn mower animation exercise Push-ups repair Wrench repair garden Garden spade

docs.title: 🔧 Customization Hooks
docs.text:
Defined in open/custom.lua. These are called automatically by the script.

Hook When it fires Custom.GetVIPTier On player connect — return VIP tier Custom.OnQuestComplete When a player completes a quest Custom.OnDailyClaim When a player claims their daily reward Custom.OnMilestoneReached When a streak milestone is hit Custom.OnStreakLost When a player loses their streak Custom.ModifyRewards Modify rewards before they are given Custom.GiveExtraRewards Give extra rewards after default ones

docs.title: Discord Logging
docs.text:
Custom.Discord = {
    Enabled = true,
    WebhookURL = "https://discord.com/api/webhooks/...",
    BotName = "CheesyScripts",
}

docs.title: 💬 Commands
docs.text: Command Description /daily Open the daily quests & rewards menu /dailyadmin Open the admin menu (requires permission)

docs.title: 📖 Feature Overview
docs.text: ✔ Daily & Weekly Quest System ✔ Login Streak with Multipliers & Milestones ✔ Streak Freeze Protection ✔ VIP Reward Multipliers ✔ Weekend Bonus Rewards ✔ Leaderboard ✔ Discord Logging ✔ In-Game Admin Menu ✔ Multi-Framework Support (ESX, QBCore, QBox) ✔ Fully Customizable Quests & Hooks

docs.title: 🛠️ Support
docs.text: If you encounter issues: 1. Check F8 console for errors 2. Verify ox_lib and oxmysql start before cs_daily 3. Confirm installation/query.sql was imported 4. Check item names in open/quests.lua match your inventory system 5. Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/qrAdgGDnvB

docs.title: ⚖️ cs_weighstation Documentation
docs.text: cs_weighstation is a configurable vehicle weight station system for FiveM. Players or job restricted staff can weigh vehicles to check cargo load — with a clean UI showing items, weights, and load limits.

docs.title: 📦 Installation
docs.text:
1. Place cs_weighstation inside your resources folder
  2. Add to your server.cfg:
ensure cs_weighstation
  1. Configure config.lua to match your server setup

docs.title: 🔍 Version Check
docs.text:
Config.VersionCheck = true
Option Description true Console will notify if the script is outdated false Disable version checking

docs.title: 🌐 General
docs.text:
Config.Locale = 'en'
Config.Debug = false
Config.ShowItems = true
Config.Framework = 'auto'
Config.InventorySystem = 'auto'
Config.Target = 'auto'
Option Description Locale Language: en, nl, de Debug Show zone debug boxes in-game ShowItems Show individual items in the UI (false = only show total weight) Framework auto, esx, qbcore, or qbox InventorySystem auto, ox_inventory, or qb-inventory Target auto, ox_target, or qb-target

docs.title: 📍 Default Blip
docs.text:
Config.DefaultBlip = {
    sprite = 50,
    color = 5,
    scale = 0.8,
}

Applies to all weight stations on the map. Adjust sprite/color using the FiveM blip reference.

docs.title: ⚖️ Load Limits
docs.text:
Config.UseLoadPercentage = true
Config.LoadPercentage = 0.30
Option Description UseLoadPercentage true = limit based on % of vehicle weight, false = use class limits LoadPercentage Fraction of vehicle weight allowed as cargo (0.30 = 30%)

When UseLoadPercentage = false, limits are set per vehicle class in Config.VehicleLoadLimits.

docs.title: Vehicle Class Limits (kg)
docs.text:
Only used when UseLoadPercentage = false:

Class Type Limit 0 Compacts 500 1 Sedans 600 2 SUVs 800 8 Motorcycles 200 10 Industrial 2000 12 Vans 2500 16 Planes 20000 20 Commercial 2500 ... (see config) ... 
Config.DefaultLoadLimit = 500 -- Fallback if vehicle class is not listed

docs.title: 🚦 Zone Cones
docs.text:
Config.ShowZoneCones = true

Spawns orange traffic cones at the corners of each weighing zone so drivers know exactly where to stop.

docs.title: 🏗️ Weight Stations
docs.text:
Defined in Config.WeightStations. Each station has weighing zones and interaction zones.

{
    name = "Weight Station 1",
    weighingZones = {
        {
            coords = vector4(x, y, z, rotation),
            size = vector3(width, length, height)
        },
    },
    interactionZones = {
        {
            coords = vector4(x, y, z, rotation),
            size = vector3(width, length, height)
        },
    },
    allowedJobs = {"police", "mechanic"} -- Leave empty for all jobs
}
Field Description name Station label shown in-game weighingZones Box zones where a vehicle must be parked to be weighed interactionZones Clickable target zones (e.g. kiosk location) allowedJobs Job whitelist — leave empty {} to allow everyone

You can add multiple weighing zones and multiple interaction zones per station.

docs.title: 🖥️ Usage
docs.text:
1. Drive a vehicle onto a weighing zone
  2. Walk to an interaction zone
  3. Interact using the target system
  4. The UI shows vehicle weight, cargo items, and load status
  5. Press ESC to close

docs.title: 🌍 Localization
docs.text:
Translation files are in the locales/ folder:

File Language en.json English nl.json Dutch de.json German

Edit these files to customize all labels, notifications, and UI text.

docs.title: 📖 Feature Overview
docs.text: ✔ Vehicle Weight Checking ✔ Per-Station Job Restrictions ✔ Percentage or Class-Based Load Limits ✔ Item List in UI (toggleable) ✔ Traffic Cone Zone Markers ✔ Multi-Framework Support (ESX, QBCore, QBox) ✔ Auto-Detection for Framework, Inventory & Target ✔ Multiple Weighing & Interaction Zones per Station

docs.title: 🛠️ Support
docs.text: If you encounter issues: 1. Set Config.Debug = true to visualize zones 2. Check F8 console for errors 3. Make sure your framework starts before cs_weighstation 4. Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/qrAdgGDnvB
